authority_ranking.description: Binding national legislation and EU legal acts; verify applicable version and legal effect.
Relevant court judgments and binding authority rulings within their legal scope; check finality and applicability.
NAV and European Commission guidance; authoritative administrative support, not legislation.
Official registers, technical specifications and operational documentation; authoritative for system facts only.
Software/provider documentation; describes product behavior, never legal authority.
Professional commentary; issue-spotting only and never sole support for a material tax conclusion.

sources.title: 2007. évi CXXVII. törvény az általános forgalmi adóról
sources.notes: NJT search-index excerpt identifies Article 37(1)-(2) general B2B/B2C text. Direct page access failed in this run; this entry is NOT treated as verified evidence for approval.

sources.authority: National Tax and Customs Administration of Hungary (NAV)
sources.title: Emelkedik az alanyi adómentesség értékhatára
sources.notes: Page read. NAV states HUF 20m domestic ceiling for 2026, HUF 22m for 2027 and HUF 24m for 2028; conditions and transitional rules also apply. Guidance is not legislation. Exact legislation and eligibility must be checked for each tax year.

sources.authority: National Tax and Customs Administration of Hungary (NAV)
sources.title: Új lehetőség a kisvállalkozásoknak az uniós alanyi adómentesség, azaz az SME-rendszer
sources.notes: Page read. NAV describes cross-border SME framework and relevant Áfa tv sections 195/A–195/K. Confirm current rules, elections, country thresholds and taxpayer status.

sources.authority: National Tax and Customs Administration of Hungary (NAV)
sources.title: Online-Invoice public technical repository and developer documentation entry point
sources.notes: NAV repository README identifies current API documentation entry point and links the NAV developer documentation. A versioned English interface specification dated 2025-01-30 was located. Confirm current API/schema version before technical implementation; this is not legal authority.

sources.title: Council Directive 2006/112/EC on the common system of value added tax
sources.notes: Specific consolidated text dated 2025-01-01; retained as a historical snapshot. A newer official consolidated snapshot dated 2025-04-14 is separately registered. EUR-Lex consolidated texts are documentation tools; authentic acts in the Official Journal control.

sources.title: Council Directive (EU) 2020/285 amending VAT rules for the special scheme for small enterprises
sources.notes: EUR-Lex record identifies current consolidated version 2025-01-01. Read with Directive 2006/112/EC as amended and national implementation.
relevant_provisions: Amendments concerning SME special scheme; effective application from 2025-01-01

sources.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/2007 laying down detailed rules for the SME special scheme
sources.notes: EUR-Lex text accessed; states applies from 2025-01-01. Verify amendments and applicable consolidated text.
relevant_provisions: Implementing rules for SME special scheme

sources.authority: European Commission, DG Taxation and Customs Union
sources.title: Place of taxation
sources.notes: Fresh European Commission DG TAXUD page read on 2026-10-08; states service nature and customer status matter, labels Articles 44/45 basic rules, and lists exceptions including Articles 47, 58 and 59c.

sources.title: VIES VAT number validation portal
sources.notes: Portal reference accessed; no VAT-ID lookup was performed. VIES is a live verification tool, not static evidence. Store actual response/status, timestamp and consultation reference when future authorized verification is implemented.
relevant_provisions: Live VAT-ID status query; no tax exemption conclusion

sources.title: Cross-border SME scheme
sources.notes: Page read. Describes EUR 100,000 Union turnover and national threshold tests, prior notification, start date after EX confirmation, and SME/OSS jurisdiction interaction. Verify law and each Member State's current thresholds.
relevant_provisions: Cross-border SME scheme: turnover thresholds, prior notification, EX confirmation

sources.title: Check a VAT number (VIES)
sources.notes: Commission Your Europe explanation accessed; page states VIES is a search engine over national databases, errors may reflect unavailability, and validation records should be retained. Page reports last checked 2026-06-18. It is not a legal determination for a specific transaction.

sources.title: Directive 2006/112/EC consolidated text dated 2025-04-14
sources.notes: Fresh current EUR-Lex consolidated version identified as 2025-04-14. Relevant English Article 44-45 and latest Article 59c snippets accessed in official EUR-Lex indexed content; direct HTML can require anti-bot verification. Consolidation is a reference, not a separate legislative act.

sources.title: Council Directive 2008/8/EC as regards place of supply of services
sources.notes: Freshly re-opened official EUR-Lex act; Article 2 applies the Articles 44-45 general service rules from 2010-01-01. This does not establish dates for other provisions.

sources.title: Council Directive (EU) 2017/2455 amending VAT obligations for services and distance sales
sources.notes: Fresh official EUR-Lex text reviewed. Relevant Article 58 amendment/Article 59c framework; Article 58 amendment applies from 2019-01-01.

sources.authority: Hungarian National Tax and Customs Administration (NAV)
sources.title: 26A60 filing instructions: place of supply of services
sources.notes: Fresh 2026 NAV filing-instruction search result states the general B2B recipient-location and B2C supplier-location rules and references Áfa tv. 37. §. Operational guidance only; not the primary legal text.

sources.title: Council Directive (EU) 2025/516 (VAT in the Digital Age)
sources.notes: Official EUR-Lex act reviewed. Its relevant amendments to Directive 2006/112 Article 59c have effect from 2027-01-01; not applicable to 2026 transactions.

sources.title: 2007. évi CXXVII. törvény az általános forgalmi adóról — NJT version shown 2025-12-20
sources.notes: Direct official NJT page fetch succeeded on 2026-10-08. Page version header reported 2025-12-20. Article 140 states recipient tax liability when §37(1) place-of-supply rule applies; §§159(2)(c), 169(n) concern invoice obligation/data and reverse-charge mention. Version applicability to a specific transaction is not pre-judged.

sources.title: 29. információs füzet — Az általános szabályok szerint adózó áfaalanyok közösségi ügyletei (2026)
sources.notes: NAV official 2026 information booklet 29, version dated 2026-01-26. Official administrative guidance supporting reverse-charge conditions, invoice obligation and A60 scope; not primary legislation.

sources.authority: National Tax and Customs Administration of Hungary (NAV)
sources.title: 26A60 form and 2026 completion guidance
sources.notes: NAV page and filing instruction accessed 2026-10-08. Current 2026 form page lists version 3.0 dated 2026-09-02; service-supply A60-03 and service-receipt A60-04 descriptions verified. This proves reporting form guidance, not any particular transaction obligation.

sources.title: Council Directive 2006/112/EC consolidated text — 2025-04-14 version, operational provisions
sources.notes: Official EUR-Lex consolidated text accessed in English/other official language indexes on 2026-10-08. The authenticated amending acts and transaction-date consolidation govern. Directive 2025/516 has future phased amendments; check temporal applicability before use.

sources.title: 2007. évi CXXVII. törvény az általános forgalmi adóról — NJT consolidated text shown 2025-12-20
sources.notes: Direct official NJT full-text page accessed 2026-10-08; page header showed consolidated text date 2025-12-20. That consolidation date is not a global effective-from date for every provision. No transaction-specific applicability conclusion is encoded.

sources.title: Umsatzsteuer-Anwendungserlass (current consolidated administrative guidance)
sources.notes: Official BMF current UStAE PDF accessed by official search result on 2026-10-08; version date not established. Administrative interpretation only, subordinate to statute and courts. Any version-sensitive interpretation requires retrieval of dated amendment history.

sources.authority: Federal Ministry of Justice / Federal Office of Justice
sources.title: German Umsatzsteuergesetz (UStG), § 13b recipient liability
sources.notes: Official current consolidated statutory text accessed 2026-10-08. §13b(1), (5), (6), and (7) are distinct elements; the fixed-establishment non-intervention test is transaction-specific. Gesamt-UStG source citation states last amended by Art. 5 G v. 29.06.2026, BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 197; section-level amendment/effective history and transaction-date prior versions still require comparison.

sources.authority: Federal Ministry of Justice / Federal Office of Justice
sources.title: German Umsatzsteuergesetz (UStG), §§ 14 and 14a invoices
sources.notes: Official current consolidated statutory text accessed 2026-10-08. Includes mandatory particulars, invoice jurisdiction cross-reference, reverse-charge indicator and intra-EU service deadline; applicability depends on Article 219a and facts. Gesamt-UStG source citation states last amended by Art. 5 G v. 29.06.2026, BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 197; section-level amendment/effective history and transaction-date prior versions still require comparison.

Gesamt-UStG source citation states last amended by Art. 5 G v. 29.06.2026, BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 197; section-level amendment/effective history and transaction-date prior versions still require comparison.
